description: Kang Woojin is an ordinary man who has just quit his design job and become unemployed. After accompanying a friend to an audition, he unexpectedly discovers a strange ability: whenever he reads a script, he enters a mysterious subspace and experiences the character's life firsthand. He may be stabbed, become a serial killer, or even become an exorcist. When Woojin uses the experiences gained from this strange ability in his acting, everyone around him mistakes him for an extraordinary acting genius, causing one misunderstanding after another as he enters the entertainment industry.
author: Jangtan
